description: Fence Line: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Three relay posts mark the fence line in {system}. Nobody has checked them in a month. Fly close, hold, wait for each to report. Pirates are around. Shoot them if they show.
Fence line check at {station}. Easy work. Hold near each post until it pings. Keep an eye out for rustlers.
success: Posts reporting and pirates gone. {client} pays {captain}, which is more than the posts are worth.
Fence checked, rustlers run off. {client} pays.
failure: The posts are unchecked. {client} pays nothing, in the kindest possible way.
You came back empty. The fence stays dark.
radio-posts: Cass: Posts ahead, three of them. Slow down and sit, and I will keep watch.
Cass: First post on the scope. Match speed and hold. It is boring. Enjoy it.
radio-cass: Cass Tuttle, on your wing. Welcome to nowhere.
Cass: Wing's up. Do not wreck my paint, I have only the one.
radio-rustlers: Cass: Contacts behind. Three, and not friendly. I make that about right.
Cass: Rustlers. Shoot them or I will.
Cass: Three pirates. Short on everything, same as us.

description: Rail Hauler: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Homesteader {stranded} ran her tanks dry in {system}. She is drifting and the pirates have heard. Fly alongside, hold, pass fuel. Thirty seconds. They arrive in twenty.
Stranded hauler. Match her speed and hold close while you pass fuel. It is all you have to do, and the pirates will make it harder.
success: The {stranded} has fuel and a heading. {client} pays {captain}. The master sends a bag of beans and an apology for the state of her hull.
Fuel passed, pirates dead. {client} pays. Ma Perrin notes it cost three tanks.
failure: The {stranded} is lost. {client} pays nothing and the Reach goes quiet.
radio-stranded: {stranded}: Compact wing, we are bone dry. Come alongside, hold still, and please hurry.
{stranded}: Engines cold, lights low. We will take whatever you can spare.
radio-first: Cass: Two fighters ahead. Do not stop holding. I will keep them busy.
Cass: Pirates. Two. They heard the call as well.
radio-second: Cass: Gunship coming in, right. It wants the {stranded}. Do not let it.
Cass: Three fighters and a gunship, right side. They mean it.
radio-third: Cass: Frigate behind us, and fighters. Somebody is being generous.
Cass: Last of them, I hope. A frigate and three.

description: The Last Caravan: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: Four homesteader freighters are moving the last caravan of the season through {system}. They carry seed stock for three stations. Pirates know it. Escort them. Do not lose them.
A caravan of four ships, loaded with the Reach's winter stores. Get them through {system}. The pirates will try for the leaders first.
success: The caravan is through, and three stations eat this winter. {client} pays {captain}. Ma Perrin finds the money for a decent meal.
Caravan delivered and the pirates beaten. {client} pays and the Reach talks about it for a week.
failure: The caravan is broken. {client} pays nothing. Three stations go hungry.
The caravan is lost. It will be a hard winter.
radio-caravan: Cass: Four freighters and two of ours. We stay in close. Nobody gets ahead.
Cass: Caravan formed. They are slow and good-hearted.
radio-outriders: Cass: Outriders ahead. Pirates, four of them. They are testing us.
Cass: Fighters, ahead. They will go for the lead ship. Do not let them.
radio-ambush: Cass: Gunships on the right! They are aiming for the freighters!
Cass: The real attack. Three bombers and four fighters, right. Break them!
radio-rooke: Jack Rooke: Compact. Lovely evening for a toll. Pay up, or pay later.
Cass: That is Rooke, the gentleman pirate. He has a frigate, the {toll}, with him. Mind the frigate.

description: Quiet Line: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: The Lattice has parked pickets in {system}, close to our space, and has not said why. Scan them and whatever is with them. Close in, hold, do not shoot. Ships you destroy cannot be scanned.
Reconnaissance. Lattice pickets in {system}, watching the Reach. Scan every hull and keep your head down. The Marshal wants facts.
success: The scans show a hull that is not Lattice, and not any Reach yard either. It carries Unbound transponders. {client} pays {captain} and goes very quiet.
Scans taken. Someone is travelling with the Lattice. {client} pays and calls the Marshal.
failure: No scan, no facts. {client} pays nothing and sends you out again.
The scans failed. Command is guessing.
radio-pickets: Cass: Two Lattice frigates, still as stones. They do not talk. They never do.
Cass: Pickets ahead. If we are patient we can scan from seven hundred metres.
radio-stray: Cass: Odd one on the right. Small frigate, not Lattice. It does not match anything I know.
Cass: Something holding off the pickets. I do not like the shape of it.
radio-screen: Cass: Fighters on the pickets. They have not seen us. Do not startle them.
Cass: Screen of three. Quiet, now.
radio-react: Cass: Splinters! Five of them, behind us! Those are Unbound! Go!
Cass: Rim hulls! They noticed the scan. Break them, then run.
radio-wake: Cass: Jump flash. Another Unbound frigate and fighters. We have what we came for. Time to go.
Cass: Reinforcement from the far side. That is enough reconnaissance.

description: The Hard Reckoning: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: An Unbound brood fleet is coming for {system}. Everything the Compact can scrape together is out here: the {flagship} and her escort, the Marshal's own wing, and you. Relief is nine minutes off. Keep the {flagship} alive and burn the carrier.
No more dry runs. The Unbound are at the gate of {system} and we are the gate. Hold the line nine minutes. The {flagship} stays where she is. So do you.
success: Relief finds the line standing. The brood carrier {target} is a cooling hulk. {client} pays {captain} the full fee. Ma Perrin finds a bottle she has been saving.
The line held. The Reach does not forget who held it. {client} pays and the Marshal pours a drink.
failure: The {flagship} is lost and {system} with her. {client} pays nothing. The Unbound own the gate.
The line broke. The Reach is open.
radio-line: Harrow: All Compact ships, this is the Marshal. We have nine minutes. Nobody else is coming. Hold.
Harrow: The {flagship} holds. I want every wing in tight. We are short on everything but nerve.
radio-first: Cass: Splinters and gunships, ahead. Twelve of them. They go for the {flagship}.
Cass: First wave. Eight fighters, four bombers. Shoot the bombers.
radio-siege: Cass: Three frigates, left, heavy. They will pound the {flagship} if we let them.
Cass: Unbound frigates. They are slow and they hit hard.
radio-brood: Cass: A carrier, overhead. The {target}. That is the brood-mother, and she has eight more.
Cass: Jump flash. {target}, carrier class. This is the real attack.
radio-relief: Harrow: Relief is here. Well held, all of you.
Cass: Friendly column inbound. It is the best sight I have seen all year.
